## What and why

<!-- One topic per pull request. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check src tests` pass
- [ ] Tests added for new logic (tiny fixtures built inside the test, no network, no model download)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or options changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] If skills or templates changed: `src/assara/data/` and `examples/art-of-war/` copies are identical, and the PR says why
- [ ] No copyrighted material, personal data, hosts or keys
